tools.name: get_trial_access
tools.description: Get the service request and standard wallet-auth instructions. First signed execution enrolls automatically; no wallet funds or payment required.

tools.description: Write: request a wallet-rotation challenge with old_wallet/new_wallet/request_id; then submit old_proof/new_proof signed with both keys. Usage is preserved.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service · Private data: get_trial_offer, get_trial_access, rotate_trial · Public sink: rotate_trial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service · Private data: get_trial_offer, get_trial_access, rotate_trial · Public sink: rotate_trial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
